reason: 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is almost double the price - I can find similar shoes in Shorja or on the Instagram page I already use for less, and I don't have to wait three weeks. For kids' things that they outgrow fast, the fees eat the whole saving.
objection: The shipping per kilo is too heavy for cheap kids' items, and I have to pay up front to a new page I don't know yet. If something is just small or wrong size, I can't return it.
would_change_my_mind: If the total fees on a 1 kg order came down to around 12,000-13,000 so it is clearly cheaper than my usual page, and a friend or relative showed me an order that arrived fine.
